## Checklist
- [ ] One purpose; unrelated formatting, dependency or API changes are in separate PRs
- [ ] Required checks pass locally or in CI
- [ ] No IPs, internal hostnames, tokens or site-specific paths (sensitive-data check run)

- [ ] AI assistance stated, if used
